name: HELLENIC PETROLEUM S.A. Namens-
summary: HELLENIC PETROLEUM S.A. is a Greek multinational oil and gas company involved in refining, marketing, and distribution of petroleum products, as well as exploration and production of hydrocarbons. Headquartered in Athens, Greece, the company operates refineries, petrochemical plants, and a network of retail service stations throughout Greece and the Balkans. It plays a significant role in the Greek energy sector.
